title: UPSSSC UP Pollution Control Board Various Post Exam City Details 2026 Out for 115 Post
intro: UPSSSC has released official notification for UP Pollution Control Board Group C Various Posts Recruitment 2026: 115 vacancies including Junior Engineer, Accountant, Auditor, Law Assistant, Laboratory Assistant, Monitoring Assistant & more. Online application starts 02 April 2026 to 29 April 2026. Check eligibility, age limit 21-40 years, qualification, pay scale Level-2/Level-6, selection process (written exam), fees, how to apply, important dates & full details. Download UPSSSC UPPCB Advt No 02-Pariksha/2026 Notification PDF at upsssc.gov.in. Eligible candidates apply online now for UPPCB jobs 2026.
